queries: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.cost_ratio, inv.line_item_count, inv.cost_ratio / NULLIF(overall.avg_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (inv.cost_ratio / NULLIF(overall.avg_ratio, 0)) IS NULL, inv.cost_ratio / NULLIF(overall.avg_ratio, 0) DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A line's ratio is missing if derived_product_cost or derived_total_cost is NULL, or if derived_total_cost is 0 (treated as NULL to avoid division by zero).
The overall average is the average of the per-invoice cost ratios (each invoice weighted equally), not the average over all lines.
The number of line items counts every row for the invoice in Invoice_Line_Items, including lines whose ratio is missing.
If the overall average is 0, the relative ratio is NULL, and those rows sort last.

alternatives.interpretation: The line item count includes only lines with a computable ratio, that is, the lines that went into the average.

assumptions.assumption: A line's ratio is missing when derived_product_cost or derived_total_cost is NULL, or when derived_total_cost is 0 (treated as NULL to avoid division by zero).
The number of line items counts all rows for the invoice in Invoice_Line_Items, including lines whose ratio is missing.
The overall average is the unweighted average of the per-invoice cost ratios, not of all line ratios. Invoices with no computable ratio are excluded from it.
Invoices whose own cost ratio is missing are still listed, with a NULL relative ratio, and sort last. If the overall average is 0, the relative ratio is NULL.

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-invoice cost ratios, skipping invoices whose ratio is NULL. It is not the mean of all line ratios.
A line whose derived_total_cost is 0 is treated as having a missing ratio (NULLIF avoids division by zero). Lines with NULL cost values are also ignored in the average.
The number of line items counts every row in Invoice_Line_Items for the invoice, including lines whose ratio is missing.
If the overall average is 0, the relative ratio is NULL (division by zero is avoided), and those rows sort last.
